Lina M: Quick sync — we need a compact launch brief (single-sheet) for enterprise prospects that ties to the upcoming webinar. Focus: security, SLAs, deploy modes. Keep it skimmable for AEs.
Arun (PM): Can we also surface a tiny benchmark callout (throughput / p95 token latency) so engineering customers see numbers? One short stat + link to full benchmark.
Riley (Sales): Yes please. Also add an "ask these questions" mini-list for discovery: residency, p95/p99 latency needs, avg qps, and compliance controls.
Becca (Content): I drafted a hero + 4 micro-bullets in the doc. Pasting condensed version: 
Becca (Content): ```
Hero: Production-grade LLM inference — secure, predictable, and deployable where you need it.
Bullets:
• Enterprise controls: KMS/HSM + audit logs + fine-grained RBAC
• SLA highlights: p99 availability target; Dedicated throughput SLAs; hosted fallback
• Deployment modes: Hosted API, Reserved Dedicated, Private VPC / On-prem
• Cost controls: batching, quantization recommendations, and caching tips
```
Noah (Bench): For the benchmark blurb I suggest: "Bench: 8k tokens/sec (dedicated x1), median token latency 8ms, p95 120ms at 1k qps — full results: https://bench.redwood/enterprise" Keep it short.
Cam (AE Lead): Add a 2-line AE talk track and footer differentiator. AE talk track must be usable in the first 60s of a call.
Riley (Sales): Draft talk track: "We expose the same API across hosted, reserved, and private — so you can start serverless and upgrade to Dedicated without code changes. We protect keys & logs, and we provide SLA-backed capacity for mission-critical routes."
Arun (PM): For the SLA sentence let's be explicit but short: "p99 availability target; Dedicated customers get throughput SLAs and automated fallback to compatible hosted variants under pressure."
Becca (Content): Added a tiny "what to ask" box: 
Becca (Content): • Data residency / region requirement
Becca (Content): • Required latency (p95 / p99)
Becca (Content): • Expected qps and burst profile
Becca (Content): • Compliance controls: KMS, SOC2, audit retention
Lina M: Also need a single-sentence latency vs cost tradeoff for a callout.
Noah (Bench): One-liner: "Lower p99 latency -> choose Dedicated pools; optimize for cost with hosted + quantization and async batching."
Cam (AE Lead): Add a 1-line inbound routing suggestion for SDRs: "If prospect needs <150ms p99 or data residency -> route to AE for Dedicated discussion; otherwise enroll in self-serve + webinar nurture."
Riley (Sales): For the footer differentiator: "Unified runtime, unified telemetry — deploy anywhere, operate everywhere."
Becca (Content): I tightened phrasing and mocked a tiny visual ascii for routing: "Client -> Router -> [Dedicated (preferred)] -> Hosted fallback"
ops-bot: Preview ready: https://redwood-internal.preview/launch-brief/1923456789 (PDF) :white_check_mark:
